# MDL309 · `trailing-whitespace`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A comment or group header ends with spaces or tabs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | K4, case 40 |

## Why

GLib tolerates spaces after a group header and inside comments, but invisible trailing whitespace is how whitespace-only lines (MDL102) sneak into a file, and it hides real differences in reviews. Trailing whitespace in a value is a separate, more serious problem: see MDL302.

## Example

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]··
# comment \t
threads=4··
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
1:11-1:13 warning MDL309[trailing-whitespace] trailing whitespace after the group header
  fix (safe): Remove the trailing whitespace
2:10-2:12 warning MDL309[trailing-whitespace] trailing whitespace in a comment
  fix (safe): Remove the trailing whitespace
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```text
[mydumper]
# comment
threads=4··
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL309: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL309` on the line above it.
